description:
The purpose of this special notice is to notify industry of the transfer of Department of the Interior Order Number 140D0422F0327, issued under GSA MAS GS35F393CA, awarded to General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) Inc., on April 27, 2022, to the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) under new Order Number 7571MN26F80034, effective April 27, 2026.

All terms and conditions of the original order remain unchanged, including:
- Ultimate Order Value
- Period of Performance

This administrative transfer does not alter the scope of work, deliverables, or any other contractual obligations.
